links.outcome: AI breast cancer detection performance by breast density and lesion features (architectural distortion, calcification)
links.effect: Performance was good overall but differed significantly by breast density classification and by presence or absence of architectural distortion or calcification. No numbers in the abstract.
links.quote: The commercial artificial intelligence algorithm for breast cancer detection on screening mammograms performed well overall, but performance differed significantly based on breast density classification and presence or absence of architectural distortion or calcification.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation evaluating the performance of a commercial screening mammography AI algorithm across subgroups (breast density, imaging features) without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
